test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that when placed from left to right in the blanks below will complete the given

letter series.

L M N _ O L L M _ Q O L L _ N Q O _ L M N Q _ L L M
solution:
Given series: L M N _ O L L M _ Q O L L _ N Q O _ L M N Q _ L L M

Option 1) QNMLO → L M N __**Q**__ O L L M __**N**__ Q O L L __**M**__ N Q O __**L**__ L M N Q __**O**__ L L M → (It follows the pattern of: LMNQOL - LMNQOL - LMNQOL - LMNQOL - LM)

Option 2) QMNLO → L M N __Q__ O L L M __M__ Q O L L __N__ N Q O __L__ L M N Q __O__ L L M → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 3) QLMNO → L M N __Q__ O L L M __L__ Q O L L __M__ N Q O __N__ L M N Q __O__ L L M → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 4) NQLMO → L M N __N__ O L L M __Q__ Q O L L __L__ N Q O __M__ L M N Q __O__ L L M → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
